business_scope.primary_industry_name: Retail Agency for Equities, CFDs and Derivative Instruments

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Napoleonic-based codified system; Islamic Sharia is a principal source of legislation per Article 2 of the 2014 Constitution)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Bilateral Investment Treaty between the Government of the Arab Republic of Egypt and the Government of the United States of America (signed 1986, in force 1992)
Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement between Egypt and the United Kingdom and Northern Ireland (1975)
Bilateral Agreement for the Promotion and Mutual Protection of Investments between Egypt and the People's Republic of China (1994)

EU–Egypt Association Agreement (in force 2004) and EU–Egypt Trade and Development Compact (2024) including investment liberalization commitments

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering Law No. 80 of 2002, as amended by Law No. 36 of 2016, and its Executive Regulations issued by Prime Ministerial Decree No. 218 of 2018, as amended; Central Bank and Banking System Law No. 194 of 2020 (CBE AML/CFT regulations for banks and payment institutions); Capital Market Law No. 10 of 2009 (Articles 27 and 70–74) and FRA enforcement/AML rules for non-bank financial activities (ISIC 6611); Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 and Executive Regulations under Ministerial Decree No. 41 of 2021 establishing the GAFI Beneficial Ownership (UBO) Register; Law No. 8 of 2015 establishing the Terrorist Entities and Terrorists List regime.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of beneficial owner/manager passport (all ≥ 25% UBOs and managers)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or competent passport authority in the beneficial owner's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for Apostille-convention states (Egypt acceded 11 Nov 2022, effective 14 Dec 2022); otherwise Egyptian consular legalization in the issuing state

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or equivalent extract for any corporate shareholder/UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country Companies Registry / Trade Register for the corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille via competent authority of the issuing state; otherwise Egyptian consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney (POA) for the Egyptian authorized signatory / incorporation filing representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the POA grantor's domicile (foreign) or Egyptian Notary Public Authority if signed in Egypt
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (foreign POA) or direct Egyptian notarization (domestic POA)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference / source-of-funds letter issued on the founder's banking relationship and clearing status
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: The founder's commercial bank (home-country bank where applicable)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank letterhead authenticated by bank seal; apostilled or consular-legalized when the bank is outside Egypt

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Police clearance / certificate of no criminal record for directors, UBOs and the proposed AML compliance officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National police or justice authority in the person's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Egyptian consular legalization per the issuing state's treaty status

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory multi-list negative screening of all shareholders, directors, UBOs, the AML compliance officer and the brokerage's agents against (a) the Egyptian Terrorist Entities and Terrorists list (Law No. 8 of 2015), (b) the UN Security Council consolidated list, (c) EU consolidated financial sanctions, (d) OFAC SDN and country-specific (non-SDN) sanctions lists, and (e) FATF public statements / grey-list jurisdictions; enhanced due diligence and source-of-funds verification required for any politically exposed person (PEP) as defined in Law No. 80 of 2002, with senior-management approval of such relationships and ongoing (non-periodic) screening on an event-driven re-run schedule per CBE and FRA regulations.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI (General Authority for Investment and Free Zones) One-Stop-Shop electronic portal (https://www.gafi.gov.eg / Official Investment Services platform), with the final commercial name clearance recorded in the Electronic Commercial Registry under Commercial Registry Law No. 34 of 1976.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The authoritative legal name is registered in Arabic script. A Latin-script transliteration is accepted for international use but must be a direct phonetic rendering of the Arabic name and is non-authoritative. The name must include the legal-form indication 'Limited Liability Company (LLC)' or its Arabic equivalent 'شركة ذات مسؤولية محدودة' and must not be identical or deceptively similar to any existing registered Egyptian name or to a reserved name of a third party. Foreign-language names require an Arabic transliteration as part of the registration application.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Terms implying banking status ('Bank', 'Banque', 'Banking', 'Financial Institution', 'Central') without prior Central Bank of Egypt authorization
Terms implying state or public-sector affiliation ('Governmental', 'National', 'Presidential', 'Army', 'Police', 'Ministry', 'Public Authority')

Regulated financial tokens ('Securities', 'Brokerage', 'Investment', 'Asset Management', 'Portfolio', 'Hedge', 'CFD', 'Derivatives') triggering prior FRA confirmation that the licensing scope (ISIC 6611) is covered by the submitted application
Terms with religious sensitivity in connection with financial services ('Islamic Finance', 'Takaful', 'Sharia', 'Fatwa') requiring additional regulatory disclaimers and approvals

Tax-planning or jurisdiction tokens ('Offshore', 'Tax Haven', 'Free Zone', 'Trust', 'Foundations') which are not prohibited per se but trigger heightened AML/CFT scrutiny by GAFI and FRA for offshore brokerage business models
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may file a written administrative objection with GAFI's Examinations and Registration Sector through the same One-Stop-Shop portal within 15 working days, attaching the rejection grounds, three alternative Arabic name proposals and, where relevant, prior FRA/CBE authorizations for sensitive financial tokens; GAFI issues its reconsideration decision within 15 business days. A further administrative appeal may be lodged with the GAFI Complaints Committee under Law No. 34 of 1976, and judicial recourse lies with an annulment action before the Administrative Judiciary of the Council of State within 60 days from the final administrative refusal. An expedited re-filing of a modified name is permitted immediately and does not prejudice the appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for an ISIC 6611 securities brokerage: FRA licensing rules and AML Law No. 80 of 2002 require a physical Egyptian head office with dedicated client-money ledgers, a resident AML compliance officer, and board/record-keeping premises; virtual-only or co-working mail-drop addresses are rejected at the licensing stage. A placeholder service address may be utilized only for the GAFI name-reservation and UBO pre-filing phase before the physical office is contracted.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Very high: 75–85% probability of an unannounced FRA on-site inspection within the first 12 months of provisional licensing, plus ministerial inspection rights under AML Law No. 80 of 2002 (Article 17) and Capital Market Law No. 10 of 2009 (Article 27); the registered address must be staffed and operational at all times.

GAFI LLC incorporation deposit and establishment file (memorandum of association, UBO declaration filing)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: GAFI (General Authority for Investment and Free Zones)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory incorporation tariff under Companies Law No. 159 of 1981

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial Registry registration of the LLC and issuance of commercial register extract
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Electronic Commercial Registry Authority (Commercial Registry Law No. 34 of 1976)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Egyptian Notary Public notarization of the memorandum of association and company statutory books
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Egyptian Notary Public Authority (Ministry of Justice)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notary tariff (Law No. 68 of 1947 on Notary Publics)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of incorporation notice in the Official Gazette (Al-Waqa'i Al-Misriya) and a local Arabic-language daily newspaper
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Amiri Press / Official Gazette authorities and licensed daily press
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory publication tariff and prevailing press market rates

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille / consular legalization of foreign corporate founder document sets (passport copies, good standing, POA, bank letter for 4 persons)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Home-country Apostille authorities, Egyptian Embassy/Consulates abroad and Egyptian Ministry of Foreign Affairs attestation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing foreign consular tariffs and Egyptian MFA attestation fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Arabic/English translation of founding documents by licensed legal translators with notary authentication chain
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark per page (approximately 30 pages)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: FRA pre-licensing due-diligence and risk-assessment submission fee for ISIC 6611 securities brokerage (non-refundable)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: FRA published fee schedule for licensing applications of high-risk NBFI activities

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation service address and virtual communication line for GAFI/FRA file window (3 months)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Egyptian service provider / corporate secretarial firm

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal and AML advisory fee: drafting MOA, UBO/AML profiling memoranda, PEP-sanctions screening affidavits, name clearance advocacy and FRA pre-filing consultation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Egyptian licensed law firm / external legal counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for multijurisdictional pre-incorporation retainers (fixed-fee quotation)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Foundation of Egyptian joint persons and LLCs is primarily governed by Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (the law applicable to limited liability companies) and Investment Law No. 72 of 2017, which introduced the simplified Founding Declaration route before GAFI; relevant ancillary provisions are drawn from Commercial Registry Law No. 34 of 1976, Capital Market Law No. 95 of 1992 and its subsequent amendments, Law No. 10 of 2009 creating the Financial Regulatory Authority, and Anti-Money Laundering Law No. 80 of 2002. Note: FRA licensing practice restricts retail dealing licenses in securities to Egyptian joint-stock companies; if the formation vehicle remains an LLC, the organizers should convert the entity to a JSC under Law No. 159 of 1981 or hold the license through a licensed JSC subsidiary.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI), Corporate Registration Department, One-Stop Shop, Cairo, in coordination with the Commercial Registry and the Egyptian Tax Authority co-located at the GAFI integrated services window.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form 1 Founding Declaration (Iqrar Al-Ta'sis) filed through GAFI together with the notarized Articles of Association (Aqd Al-Sharika); GAFI issues the Certificate of Incorporation and the unified commercial registration extract.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 there is no statutory minimum paid-up capital for ordinary LLC incorporation; nevertheless, founding capital must be subscribed and evidenced by a bank escrow certificate at a licensed Egyptian bank. For ISIC 6611 retail securities brokerage, the FRA license requires minimum fully paid-up capital of EGP 10,000,000 (approximately USD 210,000) held in escrow or as a security deposit, with ongoing net-capital and client-asset segregation requirements under Capital Market Law regulations.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) The Founding Declaration and Articles of Association filed under Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 and Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 are ratified as the company's deed. (2) The issued share capital of EGP 10,000,000 is allotted to the founding members as per the allotment schedule; the paid-up portion remains deposited in the escrow account at a licensed bank until the FRA license is granted. (3) The registered office is fixed at the address specified in the Articles. (4) The CEO and Compliance Officer are appointed to execute the FRA licensing application, open client segregated accounts, and complete all incorporation formalities. (5) All acts lawfully taken in furtherance of formation are ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation and Pre-Admission Screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Investor Services Center and online one-stop portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File an online name reservation request on the GAFI e-portal, indicating up to three alternative names in Arabic and English for the securities brokerage entity; pay the reservation fee through the national e-payment gateway; obtain GAFI administrative clearance of the selected name against the Commercial Registry index; the name reservation certificate is valid for six months and is required before document notarization.
required_dossiers: GAFI online name reservation application
Copies of founders' national ID cards or passports
Power of attorney legalized in Arabic if the incorporator acts for the founders
E-payment receipt of the name reservation fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused for identity similarity, submit a written objection to the GAFI Commercial Registry Directorate within seven days or immediately file a substituted name list; the reservation fee is refundable where the refusal results from an administrative error.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Notarization, and Escrow Funding of the Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Egyptian notary public and GAFI attestation desks, in coordination with the commercial bank holding the capital escrow account
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Arabic Articles of Association reflecting the LLC's capital structure, corporate objects covering securities brokerage, managers, and AML/CFT-oriented governance provisions; the founders or their attorneys execute the charter before the notary or GAFI attestation officer; open the corporate escrow account at a licensed Egyptian bank and deposit the minimum paid-up capital, obtaining the bank's paid-up capital certificate.
required_dossiers: Draft Arabic Articles of Association, in three counterparts
Form 1 Founding Declaration containing founder declarations
Bank certificate confirming deposit of the fully paid-up capital in escrow
Lawful power of attorney for any founder lending representation
Passport or national ID copies of all subscribing members
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or GAFI attestation desk flags missing legalization of foreign signatures, complete embassy legalization via the Consular Affairs Department within ten days; a stale bank certificate may be reissued by the depository bank on written request.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI Incorporation Filing and Automatic Commercial Registry Enrolment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Central One-Stop Shop, Company Registration Department, Cairo
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Deposit the notarized incorporation file at the GAFI one-stop window; GAFI verifies the founders' legal capacity, consistency of corporate objects with Capital Market Law restrictions, and absence of disqualifying entries; upon clearance GAFI issues the Certificate of Incorporation and books the LLC in the Commercial Registry; obtain the commercial registry extract and the unified certificate enabling tax registration.
required_dossiers: Notarized Form 1 Founding Declaration and Articles of Association
GAFI name reservation certificate
Bank escrow certificate evidencing fully paid-up capital
Board declaration accepting directorship
GAFI fee deposit receipts
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI issues a deficiency query, cure it by supplementary factual statement within ten business days; refusal of filing may be appealed administratively to the GAFI Board and thereafter to the Administrative Judicial Court within sixty days of notification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, VAT, and Social Insurance Registration at the Integrated One-Stop Hub
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) and National Organization for Social Insurance, co-located at the GAFI integrated services center
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the ETA taxpayer form and obtain the tax card, VAT registration, and payroll setup; enroll directors and employees with the National Organization for Social Insurance; execute employment contracts compliant with Labor Law No. 12 of 2003; obtain the corporate tax identification number and VAT certificate required prior to the FRA license background review.
required_dossiers: GAFI Certificate of Incorporation and commercial registry extract
Notarized registered-office lease or equivalent title document
IDs of the manager, shareholders, and financial officer
Bank statement confirming fully paid-up capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax card issuance is delayed, apply directly to the ETA head-office registration directorate with the commercial extract; ETA must issue or object within five working days; unresolved objections may be raised through the ETA internal complaint portal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Financial Regulatory Authority Dealing License for Securities Brokerage
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Financial Regulatory Authority, Non-Banking Capital Markets Licensing Directorate, with subsequent coordination at the Egyptian Exchange for product access
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the complete Arabic license dossier under Capital Market Law No. 95 of 1992 for retail dealing in equities, CFDs, and eligible derivative instruments; demonstrate the minimum fully paid-up capital at the FRA requirement, good repute of shareholders, and the AML/CFT compliance framework addressing the High_Risk_Special_License client class; the FRA examines the application, governance manual, and client-asset segregation scheme and issues the dealing license with prudential conditions; after issue, maintain net-capital and regulatory reporting obligations.
required_dossiers: FRA standardized license application form for the Capital Markets Sector
Notarized Articles of Association, Certificate of Incorporation, and commercial extract
Opening audited balance sheet prepared by an auditor registered with FRA
AML/CFT compliance manual and risk-based KYC procedure implementing Law No. 80 of 2002
Police clearances and financial standing evidence for shareholders, directors, and principal officers
Bank certificate evidencing the EGP 10,000,000 capital security deposit or escrow
Corporate governance manual, conflict-of-interest policy, and business continuity plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: On a FRA deficiency letter, the applicant has thirty days to cure the file; refusal may be contested by written reconsideration to the FRA Board within thirty days and thereafter by judicial review before the competent administrative court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Egyptian Exchange Membership and Clearing Registry Admission
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: The Egyptian Exchange, Membership Affairs Department, and Misr for Central Clearing, Depository and Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After license issuance, file the EGX membership dossier addressing trading access for equities and eligible derivatives; register with the clearing depository, open segregated client custody accounts, and execute Arabic client agreements incorporating risk disclosure schedules, CFD and derivative warning languages, and the conflict-of-interest provisions; satisfy the exchange guarantee-fund contributions and operational readiness review.
required_dossiers: FRA dealing license and current good-standing letter
Board resolution of the LLC resolving EGX membership and designated operational managers
Segregated client account documentation and custody arrangements
EGX membership application and clearing guarantee fee proof
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If EGX conditions admission, cure the operational procedure gaps within twenty days; a membership refusal is appealable to the EGX board and thereafter may be mediated through FRA under Law No. 10 of 2009.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Financial Regulatory Authority, Non-Banking Capital Markets Sector, in coordination with the Egyptian Exchange Membership Affairs Committee and Misr for Central Clearing, Depository and Registry.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: FRA Securities Dealing License (Rokhsat Al-Ta'amul fi Al-Awraq Al-Maliyya) authorizing retail agency brokerage in equities, CFDs, and eligible derivative instruments, together with Egyptian Exchange membership; the license carries High_Risk_Special_License prudential and AML/CFT conditions.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency, Ministry of Environment, Cairo
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C Registration and Low-Impact Office Use under Environment Law No. 4 of 1994 as amended by Law No. 9 of 2009, Implementing Regulation Decree No. 338 of 1995, and the Executive List of Projects; a full EIA Report is not required for a brokerage trading floor and administrative offices, and the applicant lodges only a simplified environmental registration checklist.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance thresholds applicable to the licensed premises: no significant stationary combustion or VOC emission sources beyond ordinary HVAC; workplace noise under 90 dB(A) per occupational exposure Decree No. 471 of 2006; sanitary wastewater only, meeting Law No. 93 of 1962 sewer standards of pH 6-9, BOD not exceeding 350 mg/L, TSS not exceeding 400 mg/L; UPS batteries, e-waste, and any residual hazardous substances must be consigned to licensed waste handlers under hazardous waste regulations Decree No. 153 of 2016; indoor air exposure adheres to occupational threshold limits in Decree No. 471 of 2006.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense Directorate fire safety certificate and periodic inspection under Law No. 112 of 1996; structural load inspection certificate under Building Law No. 119 of 2008 covering the trading floor, server vault, and equipment weights; occupancy clearance under Labor Law No. 12 of 2003 and Executive Regulation Decree No. 173 of 2003 including evacuation plans, fire suppression equipment, first aid, and server-room fire control measures.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) – Ministry of Finance; unified digital portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg; e-invoicing and e-receipts clearance portal: https://einvoice.invoicing.eta.gov.eg; SCZONE one-stop-shop for licensed zone projects.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For EG_LLC (foreign-owned Egyptian Limited Liability Company engaged in regulated securities brokerage): (1) incorporate before the Commercial Registry and obtain the Commercial Registration Certificate plus the FRA (Financial Regulatory Authority) brokerage licence; (2) submit to the competent ETA taxpayer service office the registry certificate, notarised memorandum of association, board resolution appointing the resident legal representative, certified power of attorney, registered-office lease, and beneficial-owner identification to obtain the unified Tax Card (TIN) under Law 91/2005; (3) file the VAT registration declaration with the ETA within 30 days of exceeding the EGP 500,000 threshold, appointing a local VAT representative; (4) register the company ERP and authorised signatory digital certificates on the ETA e-invoicing platform; the ETA issues a single electronic TIN linked to the tax card, VAT account, e-invoicing profile and customs exporter code.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box pass-through election is recognised; an Egyptian LLC is statutorily an entity-level taxpayer at the 22.5% corporate income tax rate, with branch/withholding and transfer-pricing rules applied separately. Available elections include: (i) consolidated group taxation for related Egyptian companies (restricted approval by the ETA/Minister of Finance); (ii) free-zone project exemption election under Investment Law 83/2002 and SCZONE regime where the licensed activity is physically performed in an approved zone; (iii) export-income incentive deduction elections; (iv) simplified transfer-pricing documentation election for controlled transactions below the statutory threshold. No hybrid-mismatch check-the-box elections exist; Law 177/2020 anti-abuse provisions disallow interest/dividend deductibility in arrangements exhibiting hybrid mismatch outcomes.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) – Law No. 67 of 2016 (as amended by Law No. 177 of 2020) and ETA executive regulations
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 in annual taxable supplies (mandatory registration for resident persons); voluntary registration is permitted once annual taxable supplies exceed EGP 100,000; for non-resident suppliers without a local establishment, registration is due on the first taxable supply unless an Egyptian reverse-charge-bearer performs the accounting role.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing for all registered and ETA-designated taxpayers (B2B/B2G), phased since 2020, and mandatory e-receipts for B2C retail flows: every transaction must be transmitted to the ETA system in structured JSON/XML, signed using the taxpayer's certified digital certificate (HSM), cleared through the ETA invoice clearance house (near-real-time validation with automatic rejection of non-compliant items), and stamped with a validated QR code before the invoice is delivered to the client; integration is via REST API certified by the ETA. An invoice lacking the ETA clearance stamp is legally ineffective for input-tax deduction and triggers automated penalties; brokerage fee credit notes and cross-border service invoices must likewise pass through the same clearance pipeline.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods zero-rating: physical export and customs exit of goods from Egypt on the customs declaration. Services zero-rating: services rendered by EG_LLC to non-resident counterparties for activities performed and consumed wholly outside Egypt — offshore securities brokerage, agency and custody services to foreign clients qualify where the contract is signed with a non-resident, the execution/beneficial use occurs outside Egypt, and the consideration is received in convertible foreign currency via the Egyptian banking system. The zero rate applies to the commission/fee only and does not extend to local arranging, data or corporate services supplied to Egyptian residents.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (SAD) with ETA/approved customs gateway validation, evidencing goods exit (only for any physical instrument or tangible component of the service package)
Bill of Lading or airway bill (carrier's receipt) proving actual export out of Egypt
Inward Remittance Certificate issued by an Egyptian licensed bank evidencing full credit of the export/commission proceeds in convertible foreign currency
Signed brokerage service contract and non-residency affidavit of the offshore client (with country-of-residence evidence to support consumption outside Egypt)
VAT-compliant e-invoice with ETA clearance reference and the detailed commission/trade-ticket allocation
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The ETA triangulates e-invoice declarations, customs export data, banking remittance certificates and the client's non-residency documentation. Where zero-rating is claimed without proof of actual export/offshore consumption or of timely inward remittance, the ETA claws back the VAT at the 14% standard rate (or the applicable special rate for goods) on the entire invoice value, adds delay tax of 2% per month on the unpaid tax, and imposes statutory evasion penalties ranging from 100% to 200% of the evaded tax; wilful fraudulent documentation exposes the legal representative, tax representative, signatories and — where chain fraud is proven — the receiving bank to joint and several liability, cancellation of the tax card, blacklisting from e-invoicing, criminal fines and imprisonment under Law 67/2016 (as amended) and the Unified Tax Procedures provisions.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) in conjunction with the Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) for capital market intermediation activities
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Egyptian pound (EGP) operates under a liberalized managed float regime. Current account payments, including dividend distributions and service fees, are generally remittable through CBE-authorized banks upon presentation of documentary evidence comprising audited financial statements, tax clearance certificates and, for regulated financial entities, an FRA no-objection. Capital account transactions, including shareholder equity injections and offshore loan repayments, require bank-level verification against the CBE External Transactions Classification and may attract enhanced due diligence; approval friction is moderate for a licensed broker. Profit remittance hurdles are therefore administrative rather than structural, contingent on proof of tax settlement, compliance with CBE anti-money-laundering checks and FRA notification.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Egyptian exporters must repatriate export proceeds through an Egyptian bank within 90 days of shipment, extendable to 270 days with CBE approval, and may retain the full proceeds in a foreign currency account or convert them at the interbank rate; mandatory surrender ratios were abolished in 2024 and no forced conversion percentage is currently imposed, although the CBE reserves the right to re-impose calibrated surrender requirements for balance-of-payments stability. For this non-exporting securities broker the regime applies only indirectly: all cross-border receipts, including client subscription funds and shareholder capital, must be routed through CBE-licensed banks and recorded under the applicable external transactions code.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Regulatory viability of offshore digital EMIs is Low. Egypt does not recognize foreign e-money institution authorizations; only CBE-licensed payment service providers and FRA-licensed fintech entities may hold client moneys for brokerage flows. Offshore EMIs such as Wise or Payoneer may be used strictly as ancillary collection or disbursement channels routed onward to a licensed Egyptian bank, never as the primary segregated client money custodian. Domestic payment acceptance is required through licensed processors including Fawry, EFin and Masary.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory for at least one director or a senior authorized signatory for corporate account opening at tier-1 Egyptian banks when the entity is classified as high-risk; remote or video onboarding is permitted only for standard low-risk retail and is not available for a securities and CFD brokerage. The in-branch KYC interview requires original constitutional documents, apostilled corporate records, original passports for all non-resident directors and shareholders, Egyptian tax identifiers where applicable, and a notarized power of attorney executed by all shareholders if signatories act remotely. Some state-owned banks additionally require a pre-account product approval from their head office compliance and international division.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk business classification as retail securities and CFD brokerage triggering enhanced due diligence and elevated rejection probability at conservative state-owned banks
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid FRA brokerage licence, CBE-compliant AML/CFT internal policy and procedures manual, client money segregation framework approved by external auditors, UBO register with source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements, audited opening balance sheet, and a declaration from the appointed compliance officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident foreign ownership and ambiguity in the beneficial ownership chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized and apostilled certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles of association with a complete shareholding schedule, chain-of-title analysis, government-issued passports and proof of residential address for every 25% or greater UBO, employer references, and an endorsed corporate group structure chart from an international corporate services provider.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Negative or inconclusive sanctions and PEP screening results on directors or UBOs
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent sanctions and PEP screening reports from Refinitiv World-Check or Dow Jones Risk & Compliance, signed explanatory representations from the affected individuals, a formal legal opinion from an Egyptian law firm confirming no regulatory disqualification, and, where applicable, no-objection letters from the FRA and CBE.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Insufficient economic substance and local footprint indicating possible shell structuring
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered office lease agreement in Egypt, employment contracts and payroll records for compliance, trading and operations staff, office utility bills, board resolution confirming the main management location, and an economic-substance dossier prepared by an Egyptian audit firm.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound capital originating from FATF grey-listed or high-risk third-country jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Recent bank reference letter from the originating institution, transaction history of the funding account, source-of-funds certification executed by the remitting shareholder, valid tax residency certificates for the remitting entity and individuals, and a sworn statement confirming the funds constitute legitimate share capital rather than third-party client moneys.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder capital is routed via SWIFT MT103 from the remitting corporate bank to the company's EGP or USD account at a CBE-licensed bank, referencing the CBE Economic Classification of External Transactions code for equity participation in a limited liability company together with the shareholding percentage; client money references are strictly prohibited. For a regulated broker the inward remittance is reconciled against the share capital schedule filed with the FRA; the receiving bank completes the CBE inward transfer declaration, applies enhanced customer due diligence, and converts USD to EGP at the interbank dealable rate where an EGP operational account is required.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Settlements rely on SWIFT MT103 direct remittances for securities delivery-versus-payment flows, MT202 and MT202COV for treasury and nostrovostro movements, and commercial letters of credit for non-securities trade settlements. Egyptian equity settlements clear through Misr for Clearing, Settlement and Central Depository (MCSD) under delivery-versus-payment; international prime brokerage and CFD counterparty obligations settle by MT103 with annexed transaction advices, with rebalancing executed through the nostrovostro pool maintained by the global correspondent bank of the local clearing bank. All outbound remittances require underlying trade or margin call documentation retained for the statutory five-year AML/CFT record-keeping period.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore USD/EGP outright forwards with CBE-licensed banks for forward coverage up to twelve months based on documented dividend, commission or operational flows
Onshore FX swaps between USD and EGP executed under CBE treasury regulations
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) with international bank counterparties to hedge residual EGP exposure where onshore liquidity is insufficient
Cross-currency swaps denominated in USD, EUR or other G10 currencies with OECD-regulated bank counterparties to stabilize non-EGP working capital flows

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Form 41) and supporting schedules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 April following the tax year-end (within 4 months of year-end under Income Tax Law 91/2005)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest of 2% per month on the unpaid tax plus late-filing fines; enforcement measures include bank garnishment, asset attachment, and criminal penalties for fraudulent returns under Law 91/2005

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited Annual Financial Statements with the independent auditor's report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) under Capital Market Law 95/1992
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months after the fiscal year-end (31 March for calendar-year companies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine up to EGP 100,000 and suspension of the brokerage license; repeated default carries revocation of the FRA brokerage license

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Commercial Registry data confirmation and 5-year renewal touchpoint
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry Office, Ministry of Trade and Industry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 5-year renewal cycle with mandatory update within 15 days of any change in registered particulars; prorated annual compliance touchpoint
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-renewal fines of EGP 300 to EGP 5,000; lapse of registration results in loss of legal standing; failure to renew for six months triggers administrative strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Tax Registration / Tax Card validity confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation accompanying the CIT filing; tax card validity follows a 5-year renewal cycle
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Invalid tax registration prevents import/export clearance and public tender participation; ETA fines up to EGP 50,000 for registration irregularities

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: FRA annual supervision fee and compliance attestation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 January for the preceding licensed calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: One-month grace period then 5% surcharge and license suspension; persistent non-payment leads to cancellation of the brokerage license under Capital Market Law 95/1992

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Egyptian Exchange (EGX) and MCDR membership annual dues
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: The Egyptian Exchange (EGX) and Misr for Central Clearing, Depository and Registry (MCDR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 31 January of the continuing membership year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Suspension of trading platform access and clearing privileges; disciplinary fines and penalties imposed under the EGX Rulebook

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) register annual confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment (GAFI) and FRA
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 15 days after any change in UBO or shareholding structure; minimum once per calendar year aligned with the CIT filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines under AML Law 80/2002 up to EGP 500,000; director personal liability; repeated omission creates strike-off risk

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory for all Egyptian LLCs irrespective of turnover; no revenue-based exemption under Companies Law 127/2023. FRA additionally requires an FRA-authorized independent certified auditor for licensed securities brokers.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS) issued under Ministerial Decision and aligned with IFRS; FRA mandates EAS/IFRS-compliant financial statements for capital market entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under AML Law 80/2002 and Companies Law 127/2023, the LLC must maintain a current UBO register, file UBO declarations with GAFI within 15 days of any shareholding transfer or ownership change, and reconfirm the UBO data at least annually with the corporate tax filing. The Commercial Registry update for member changes is due within 15 days of the transfer.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000 – 9,000 per annum for an FRA-authorized certified audit with capital market experience

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Qualifying projects under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 may receive a reduction of up to 50% of corporate tax for up to 5 years; properly licensed free-zone entities may apply a 5% tax on exported service revenues instead of full CIT, subject to ETA authorisation and activity eligibility.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Egyptian corporate income tax return Form No. 19 (Law 91/2005), filed via the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) electronic filing portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual filing with quarterly provisional tax declarations
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 4 months after the end of the approved tax year; a calendar-year taxpayer must file by 30 April of the following year

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification data, including Egyptian tax card number and legal representative details
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Egyptian tax card number for the Egyptian LLC and the foreign parent's country of residence; attach the Tax Residency Certificate if treaty relief is claimed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross sales and service revenue from all activities
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only Egyptian-source revenue of the resident LLC. A non-resident broker-dealer without a permanent establishment is not subject to filing; the LLC itself reports all Egyptian brokerage revenue.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of goods sold and direct operating expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductible only where supported by invoices, bank-transfer trails, and Egyptian withholding tax certificates for cross-border services.
Enter related-party interest net of any Egyptian withholding tax; failure to withhold will disallow the deduction.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income before loss carry-forward
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must equal audited profit after statutory book-tax reconciliations and any transfer-pricing adjustments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible tax losses brought forward (max 5 years)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only the resident Egyptian entity may carry losses forward; ensure the 5-year limitation and ownership continuity condition under Egyptian tax law are satisfied.
Apply the 22.5% rate to taxable income, then subtract quarterly provisional payments and foreign tax credits, if any.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Administrative fines for late filing (EGP 1,000–5,000); monthly delay surcharge of 3% on unpaid tax; criminal prosecution for deliberate omissions; licence suspension by the Egyptian Financial Regulatory Authority.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on profit distributions to non-resident shareholders under Law 91/2005; reduced to 5%–10% under many of Egypt's comprehensive double tax treaties
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To apply a treaty-reduced dividend withholding rate, the beneficial owner must submit an official Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by its residence tax authority, a certificate of beneficial ownership, and a completed ETA treaty-relief request through the ETA e-portal or the competent tax office. The request must be made before or at the time of distribution; otherwise the statutory rate is withheld and a refund may be claimed within the applicable limitation period. The Egyptian payer retains a copy of the approval to justify non-withholding at the higher statutory rate.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic law: 20% withholding tax applies to gross interest and royalties paid to non-residents; under most Egyptian DTAs, interest is capped at 10%–15% and royalties at 10%–12%, subject to the same TRC and beneficial-ownership procedure.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EGP 5,000,000 annual aggregate related-party transactions triggers mandatory Local File / Master File preparation; Country-by-Country Report filing is required where consolidated group revenue exceeds EGP 8,000,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt applies general anti-avoidance and treaty-access substantive tests rather than a standalone ESR regime. A securities-brokerage LLC must maintain a licensed office, employed investment advisers, real business records, boards, and key management in Egypt; shell vehicles without economic activities will be denied treaty benefits and can have tax registration revoked. The Egyptian Financial Regulatory Authority independently requires a physical presence, compliance officers, and capital adequacy so as to avoid shell-company abuse.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Suppression of securities brokerage fees, fabrication of invoices, or failure to file the corporate tax return with intent to evade tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment for 2–5 years and a fine of up to EGP 100,000, in addition to an additional tax of 100% of the evaded tax and a monthly 3% late-payment surcharge.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and founding partners who sign false returns can be jointly liable for the tax debt and may face travel bans, seizure of personal assets, and imprisonment under Law 91/2005.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Recording profits in a non-resident affiliate or zero-tax jurisdiction without arm's-length compensation, absence of the required Local/Master File, or mispricing securities brokerage commissions between broker and client affiliates.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: An upward transfer-pricing adjustment by the ETA, a late-payment surcharge, an administrative fine of up to 30% of the adjustment, and potential criminal penalties for presenting fraudulent transfer-pricing documentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Board members who directed artificial profit shifting face personal assessment, freezing orders on overseas assets, and piercing of the corporate veil where funds are extracted as undisclosed distributions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell company / money laundering in securities brokerage
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Egyptian LLC as a shell conduit for client fund layering, nominee shareholding, false economic-substance filings, or processing retail brokerage payments through Visa/Mastercard without physical trading infrastructure or AML controls.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Egyptian Anti-Money Laundering Law No. 8/2002 and the Financial Regulatory Authority licensing regime: revocation of the securities brokerage licence, confiscation of proceeds, fines up to EGP 1,000,000, and imprisonment of up to 7 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are subject to personal punishment, including travel bans and restitution to defrauded clients; the corporate veil will be pierced where shell vehicles are used for fraudulent transaction routing.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Withholding tax and dividend repatriation failure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Distributing profits to a foreign parent without applying the statutory or treaty withholding tax, or failing to withhold on cross-border interest and royalty payments.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The ETA will collect the unwithheld tax from the Egyptian LLC together with a monthly surcharge of 3% and an additional penalty of 30%–100% of the unremitted amount.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Officers who approve distributions without withholding are personally liable for the cumulative tax, plus possible criminal punishment for intentional non-compliance; travel restrictions can be imposed pending settlement.
